metaTitle: Shimuja Ramen Case Study: 15.4M Views | Button Up Media
metaDescription: How Button Up Media's social media marketing helped Shimuja Ramen reach 15.4M views while the shop moved from Southwest Ranches to downtown Miami.
ldHeadline: Shimuja Ramen: 15.4M social media views for a downtown Miami ramen shop
answer: Shimuja Ramen is at Julia & Henry's food hall in downtown Miami. Our short videos focus on the ramen and have reached 15.4M views on social media.
timeframe: About 4 years, by Chef Kei's count

hero.alt: Chef Kei, owner of Shimuja Ramen, at his restaurant

card.alt: Chef Kei, owner of Shimuja Ramen
card.label: social views

metrics.label: Social media views
metrics.meaning: Instagram Reels 11.1M, TikTok 2.7M, Facebook 1.3M and the rest on YouTube, measured in Sprout Social from January 2022 to November 2026.

metrics.label: Working together
metrics.meaning: That's how long Chef Kei says we've worked together, in his video testimonial.

metrics.label: Locations so far
metrics.meaning: Southwest Ranches, pop-ups at Baby Jane in Brickell and in Sunset Harbour, and now Julia & Henry's.

paragraphs: Shimuja has moved more than once. It started in Southwest Ranches in Broward, ran pop-ups at Baby Jane in Brickell and at Sunset Harbour in Miami Beach, and now serves ramen at Julia & Henry's in downtown Miami.
Each move meant telling regular customers where to find the shop and introducing it to people in a new area.

items.title: Make the ramen the focus
items.bodyHtml: We shoot short videos with the bowls of ramen as the main subject.

items.title: Give every video one goal
items.bodyHtml: Each video is meant to get people to come in and eat at Shimuja.

items.title: Keep at it over the years
items.bodyHtml: We've handled Shimuja's social media for about four years, by Chef Kei's count.

points: In his video testimonial, Chef Kei says a lot of the customers who come try his ramen come directly from our social media marketing.

quote.text: I can see a lot of customers that come try my ramen come directly from the social media marketing Button Up has done for me, and I'm very grateful for what they've done for Shimuja in the 4 years we've been working with them.
